description.from: Agreed plan (2026-10-05): separate feature admission from fitted-classifier promotion. Current three-control scheduler bundles supporting questions; a losing bundle does not disprove individual concepts. Implement in order: (1) persistent individual feature bank with stable identity, wording revisions, intended concept, options, training evidence references, rationale, lineage, coverage and trial history; proposed/measured/deferred/deployed states, no permanent deletion on failure; (2) descriptive class-conditional probability/missingness diagnostics with counts, not held-out performance claims; (3) one-question additions against one frozen incumbent rubric/example list/model/partitions/weighting/fit, cached full requests and explicit budgets; (4) bounded pairs/groups and leave-one-question-out ablations for incremental value, redundancy and interactions; (5) wording refinement using training feedback only and fair retry as evidence grows; (6) reusable lifecycle events and Rich inspection of feature bank, trial diffs, actual optimizer exchanges, Jev requests, fits and deployment. Keep measured Brier promotion gate: any strict improvement currently qualifies, so do not merely lower a nonexistent large threshold. Development/audit labels must never enter optimizer briefing or demonstrations; sealed scoreboard must not steer search. Specs first with fake clients for isolation, deterministic budgets, revisions/retries, restart safety and failed-trial incumbent preservation. First milestone: auditable single-feature addition through decision answers, numerical fit and visible development result. Combination experiments follow after verification. Evaluations go in the separate evaluations repository; no DSPy, retrieval or input filtering. This is planned work, not implemented capability.
description.to: Replacement plan agreed 2026-10-05: independent stages for few-shot experimentation, continuous main-rubric refinement, and question discovery. Do not run all controls as one automatic winner-selection cycle. Question measurement freezes CURRENT rubric/example list/existing questions, adds one question or wording revision, and retroactively re-scores a configurable eligible human-feedback window, default cap 200. Actual available N and per-class counts must be visible; retain scarce-class coverage while favoring recency. All questions get matched full-request answers/probabilities under the frozen context; other features may have longer histories but rank on a common window. Cache full state/question fingerprint and track feedback/context versions, usage, coverage, resumable progress. Never mix answers from different context versions as one matched trial. Human final-decision labels are the alignment target; supporting-question outputs are model-derived features, not ground truth for those questions. Direct agreement only for semantically matching final-label options; otherwise descriptive class-conditional probabilities and out-of-fold learned question-answer-to-final-label mapping, including inverse or multiclass relationships. Report raw/class-balanced alignment, majority baseline, missingness/counts and uncertainty. Agreement with model main answer is secondary, not human alignment. Retrospective feature ranking is discovery evidence, not deployment accuracy; do not gate admission on a four-item holdout comparison or claim cap200 guarantees adequate minority data. Keep protected audits/scoreboard untouched, preserve roles, omit target label/comment and own example from request. Retain concepts/revisions and rerun with new feedback/context. Downstream head refit and adequately supported promotion are distinct; combinations/ablations later. Reusable library owns separate-stage orchestration, bank/backfill/ranking/events; Rich displays stage, context versions, backfill progress, optimizer/decision exchanges, rank evidence and fits. Specs first with fakes and no DSPy. Existing implementation is individual-question trials within the older combined scheduler; replacement stage/backfill functionality is NOT implemented yet. First replacement milestone: bounded cached backfill and matched-window rank of one new question under active context.
